subject: ExplosiveKnockback
advisory: The wild tuning numbers (throw x1.6, about 70 percent kept per rebound) are playtest tuning inside his card; the scene checks the shape, not the exact numbers

leaves.oracle_proposed: proof scene calibration plus over_sandbags: landing cell 3 cells out along the blast ray, alive, stunned, journal reason thrown
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: A colonist standing one cell from a mortar shell's landing is thrown about three cells straight away from it, clean over a sandbag line, and the player sees them land alive and briefly stunned.
leaves.scenario: Quicktest map, minimal list: a colonist one cell east of a mortar impact point, a sandbag line two cells further east; the shell lands; read the colonist's cell and health after landing.
false_pass: the colonist is moved by a teleport with no arc on screen
the colonist is thrown but dies of the impact
the throw stops at the sandbags
leaves.red: a build where the colonist stays in place or stops in front of the sandbags

leaves.oracle_proposed: proof scene wall_stop: landing on the cell before the wall, impact damage above 0, no further move
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: A colonist thrown toward a wall stops dead on the cell before it, takes an impact hit, and the player never sees them rebound.
leaves.scenario: A colonist two cells from a wall with the blast on the far side; read the landing cell, the impact damage and any second movement.
false_pass: the colonist passes through the wall
the colonist rebounds off the wall like a good
leaves.red: a build where thrown people bounce off walls or stop with no impact damage

leaves.oracle_proposed: proof scene shield_counter: same cell after, energy drop larger than the plain absorb
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: A pawn whose shield belt absorbs the blast stays where they stood, and the player sees the belt lose extra charge.
leaves.scenario: A colonist wearing a charged shield belt beside a grenade blast; read position and belt energy before and after.
false_pass: the belt absorbs the damage but the wearer is still thrown
the wearer stays put but the belt loses only the ordinary charge
leaves.red: a build where a shielded colonist is thrown, or the belt pays nothing extra

leaves.oracle_proposed: a per-tick trace of each thrown thing: height above zero mid-path, rotation changing, at least one rebound off the wall with speed near 0.7 of before
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: Loose goods and corpses near a blast fly through the air in a high arc, spinning fast, and the player watches them rebound off walls, each time keeping about seventy percent of their speed, before they come to rest.
leaves.scenario: A 5x5 stockpile of mixed goods and a corpse beside a wall; a mortar lands in it; record each thrown thing's drawn position per tick until all are at rest.
false_pass: goods vanish and reappear at the landing cell under dust
goods slide in a straight line with no arc or spin
goods stop at the first wall
leaves.red: the built despawn and re-place hop under a dust puff

leaves.oracle_proposed: moved stacks equal stacks reached by the wave; the journal holds no overflow-dropped line
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: Every loose good the blast reaches moves, and the player never sees one stack sit still in the blast while its neighbours fly.
leaves.scenario: A mortar into a full 10x10 stockpile, one stack per cell; count stacks in the blast radius before and stacks that moved after.
false_pass: the per-tick cap silently drops the overflow and those stacks stay
far stacks hop instantly while near ones fly
leaves.red: the built per-tick item cap that drops the overflow

leaves.oracle_proposed: every good on the open furniture moved; journal holds no in_storage line for them
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: Goods on an open shelf, rack or table scatter like goods on the floor, and the player sees the shelf emptied by the blast.
leaves.scenario: A shelf, a weapon rack and a table each holding goods beside a grenade blast; read where the goods are after.
false_pass: goods on any storage building are skipped (the built in_storage rule)
only floor goods move
leaves.red: the built in_storage skip at RM_MapComponent_Knockback.cs line 399

leaves.oracle_proposed: contents counts unchanged; the free-backed container moved one cell away from the blast; the walled one stayed and jolted
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: Goods inside a closed container (a crate, locker, fridge or deep storage) stay inside it, and the player sees the container itself shift a cell or jolt.
leaves.scenario: A crate and a fridge holding goods beside a grenade blast, one with a free cell behind it and one against a wall; read contents and container cells after.
false_pass: closed containers spill their goods
the container never moves at all
a container slides into a pit, a wall or onto a pawn
leaves.red: a build where a fridge's contents scatter, or a crate is shoved into a pit

leaves.oracle_proposed: steel: blunt damage 2 to 5 and a stagger, stack stops at the colonist; cloth: no damage, passes
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: A heavy thrown stack that strikes a pawn gives a small blunt hit and a short stagger and stops there, while the player sees light goods fly past the pawn untouched.
leaves.scenario: A colonist two cells beyond a stack of steel and a stack of cloth along the blast ray; read the colonist's damage and stagger and where each stack ended.
false_pass: every good that passes a pawn hurts it
heavy stacks pass through the pawn
leaves.red: a build where flying goods never touch people, or where light cloth deals damage

leaves.oracle_proposed: throw length ratio fire to bomb near 0.5; modded explosion above 0; EMP 0 and no journal entry
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: Grenades, mortars and other bombs throw at full strength, fire and incendiary blasts at about half, and another mod's damaging explosion throws too, while the player sees EMP, smoke and other harmless bursts throw nothing.
leaves.scenario: One colonist each beside a frag grenade, an incendiary shell, a modded damaging explosion and an EMP grenade, same distance; compare throw lengths.
false_pass: fire blasts still throw nothing (the built force 0)
other mods' blasts default to 0 percent
EMP throws
leaves.red: the built Flame force 0 and the 0 percent default for other mods

leaves.oracle_proposed: bursts ordered along the fire front, one per clump cell; goods within about 1.9 cells of a burst moved at most 2 cells; colonist moved 1 cell, no new injuries, at most once per 2 seconds
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: When a flammable gas cloud catches, the player sees it go off clump by clump as the fire runs through it, each small burst scattering the goods near it and shoving a pawn one cell without hurting them.
leaves.scenario: A 40-cell flammable gas cloud over loose goods with a colonist inside; light one edge; record each burst's cell and tick, goods moved, and the colonist's moves and damage.
false_pass: the whole cloud goes off as one blast at its centre
the gas only lights fires
the colonist takes blast damage
leaves.red: a build with one centroid explosion, or none

leaves.oracle_proposed: each tagged gas yields clump bursts; the census list matches the gases carrying the tag
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: The player sees the Cauldron's gas, and every other gas of ours tagged as flammable, catch and go off clump by clump.
leaves.scenario: Release the Cauldron's gas and each tagged gas from the census in turn over loose goods and light it.
false_pass: only one test gas is wired
the Cauldron's gas burns as plain fire with no bursts
leaves.red: a build where the Cauldron's gas carries no flammable tag

leaves.oracle_proposed: proof scene cover_breaks: cover destroyed, one descent recorded; gas scene: cover hit points unchanged
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: A damaging or fire blast over a covered pit breaks its cover and the pawn standing on it falls in, while the player sees a gas burst leave a cover whole.
leaves.scenario: A raider on a covered pit; a grenade lands on the cover; separately a gas cloud bursts over a second covered pit.
false_pass: the cover breaks but the raider stands in the air
a gas burst also breaks covers
leaves.red: a build where covers survive a grenade, or crack under a gas burst

leaves.oracle_proposed: proof scenes pit_colonist and no_cross: landing in the first pit cell, one descent recorded
leaves.tier_reason: the throw, the landing and the scatter are runtime (PawnFlyer, map things, the explosion wave); the kernel selftest proves only the path maths
leaves.experience: A pawn or a good thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor, and the player never sees anything thrown across it.
leaves.scenario: A colonist and a stack beside a 1-wide open pit with the blast on the far side; read where each lands.
false_pass: the colonist is thrown over the pit to the far side
the stack lands on the pit rim

leaves.oracle_proposed: the stack reaches a stockpile outside the pit; the hauler used the ladder

leaves.oracle_proposed: the frame probe's worst frame across both events
leaves.tier_reason: frame time is meaningful only on the real list and machine
leaves.experience: at most 50 ms per frame on Archmagi, the full mod list, through a 6-shell mortar barrage into a full 10x10 stockpile and a 40-cell gas chain
leaves.scenario: The barrage and the chain at normal speed with the frame probe running; read the worst frame.
false_pass: the average frame is fine but one frame stalls
the probe measured a paused game
leaves.red: a build where all-fly stutters a barrage

leaves.oracle_proposed: rows per second near the frame rate; a deliberate 100 ms sleep shows as a 100 ms row
leaves.tier_reason: frames exist only in a running game
leaves.experience: The log records every frame's time while a blast's goods are in the air, so a tester can read the worst frame.
leaves.scenario: Start the probe, fire one grenade into goods, stop it; the log holds one row per frame with the count of things in the air.
false_pass: the probe samples once a second and misses the stall

leaves.red: a probe that reports a smooth average over a stalled frame

leaves.oracle_proposed: journals of both orders agree on throws per blast; no duplicated or lost thing after the reload; frame budget held
leaves.tier_reason: the walk is the full list, played
leaves.experience: The player plays a raid on a stocked colony on the full list: mortars into the storeroom, a grenade on a pit trap, a gas cloud lit, and every throw and scatter reads as a blast.
leaves.scenario: Full list colony with a stocked storeroom of open shelves and crates, a covered pit trap and a gas source; a mortar raid; save mid-way and reload; repeat the raid in a second order (gas first, then mortars); compare journals.
false_pass: the scenes pass alone but the raid stutters
a reload loses a thing in the air
the second order gives a different outcome
leaves.red: a build whose thrown things duplicate or vanish across a reload
